name: WF-08 — Consulta somente leitura do Estado 360 (OFFLINE_EVAL)

parameters.query:
SELECT
  $1::text AS requested_tenant_id,
  $2::text AS requested_subject_ref,
  s.state_id, s.state_version, s.event_id, s.correlation_id,
  s.state_hash, s.overall_status, s.snapshot, s.generated_at
FROM (SELECT 1) AS request_scope
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT state_id, state_version, event_id, correlation_id, state_hash, overall_status, snapshot, generated_at
  FROM state_snapshots
  WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND subject_ref = $2
  ORDER BY state_version DESC
  LIMIT 1
) s ON true;
